label: copy phase, re-input of 3rd/4th original token (n/g/p/f/z) in long sequences, specific neighbor tokens
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, never during original input or at <DEL>. Almost all mass is at recall_idx 3-4 (the input is the fed-back orig(2) or orig(3)) in sequences with L>=7, mostly L=9; there is a small extra cluster at the last step of L=9. The input token is nearly always n, g, p, f or z. It is strongest when the previous input is v/j/i/3 and the token being output is h/i/v/u/s/2, e.g. "o i [g] i" or "e v [g] h". It does not fire on first occurrences of a token. The position+token gate alone has recall 0.86 but precision 0.02. Adding the neighbor-token conditions raises F1 only to about 0.28, so the unit acts like a sparse conjunctive token-trigram detector that a small predicate cannot fully capture. Magnitude is tiny (max 0.02 above threshold); the top activations are at recall_idx 3 with in_tok g/n/p and next output h.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=n (+4.27), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+4.08), phase=2 & in_tok=p (+3.45), prev_tok=v (+2.99), phase=2 & in_tok=z (+2.97), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+2.87). Lower it: orig6=- (-2.50), next_out=q (-2.06), orig0=t (-1.68), orig5=o (-1.64).
